name: ADF_Stationarity_Test
author: Aneek Sarkar
summary: Augmented Dickey-Fuller (ADF) unit-root stationarity test with AIC, BIC, Ng-Perron MAIC, White's HC3 robust inference, Engle ARCH LM test, and diagnostic plots.
description: Performs the Augmented Dickey-Fuller (ADF) unit-root test for time-series stationarity in IBM SPSS Statistics. Supports four deterministic specifications (none, constant, linear trend, quadratic trend), automatic lag order selection (AIC, BIC/SIC, sequential t-statistic) or fixed lag, Schwert (1989) small-sample bounds, Ng & Perron (2001) Modified AIC (MAIC), MacKinnon-White HC3 heteroskedasticity-robust t-statistics, Ljung-Box serial correlation testing with exact AR degrees-of-freedom adjustment, Engle's ARCH(1) LM test, and four high-resolution diagnostic plots.
